search_information.query_displayed: how long does a bank transfer take

text_blocks.answer: Bank transfers typically take anywhere from a few minutes to five business days, depending on the transfer method you choose.

items.answer: Wire Transfers: Domestic wire transfers usually process within the same business day or under 24 hours if made before the bank's daily cutoff time.
ACH Transfers: Standard Automated Clearing House (ACH) transfers between different banks take 1 to 3 business days.
Instant P2P Apps: Services like Zelle offer transfers within minutes, while apps like Venmo or Cash App take 1 to 3 business days for standard transfers or minutes for an instant fee.
International Transfers: Moving money across borders generally takes 1 to 5 business days
Cut-Off Times: Transfers submitted after a bank's daily deadline (often between 2 p.m. and 5 p.m.) are not processed until the next business day.
Weekends and Holidays: Banks only process traditional transfers on regular business days.
Incorrect Details: Errors in the recipient's account number or routing number will stall the transaction.
